summary: Dependencies in meta/main.yml can use the full form with src and version, but Galaxy requires dependencies in namespace.role_name form, so URL sources make imports fail.
questions: Why did my role import to Galaxy fail with a URL dependency?
How do I depend on a role from a Git commit in meta/main.yml?

answer_card.title: Full-form role dependencies
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
dependencies:
  - name: geerlingguy.ansible
  - name: composer
    src: git+https://github.com/geerlingguy/ansible-role-composer.git
    version: 775396299f2da1f519f0d8885022ca2d6ee80ee8
```
**Galaxy caveat:** Galaxy expects every dependency to exist on Galaxy as `namespace.role_name`. Importing a role whose dependency `src` is a URL fails.
